ns2:section.sectionText: Focus on the communication of 20th and 21st century social movements. Examines the communication strategies of social movements, concentrating on the types of messages that social movements create (including rhetorical messaging, social protest, grassroots organizing, fundraising, and media outreach). Focus on the role of communication in identity formation, circulation, & effectivity of protest movements. Reserve for Communication/Speech Communication majors removed May 5 by 4:00pm.
